main_text.l: diluuium peccati nostri vtinam ego sic explicare possem, vt seipsum quisquè praelucente verbi diuini face, vt suum casum, sua vulnera, suum exitium, sœtorem sui, suamque perniciem ineuitabilem, tamquam in speculo, contemplans recognosceret, iustissimoque sui ipsius horrore (nam quid tanto opere in vobis plausibile?) extra se & supra hunc peruersum mundum ad Deum salutis nostrae confugeret.

Nam exponerem ante ora & oculos (si possem) omnium studiosissimè summam illam atque reuerendam maiestatem Dei, bonam erga omneis atque beneficam, à malo reuocantem & prouocante ad bonum veritate sermonis sui, mala hæc medi-

page.notes: Lower-right of page: "medi-" is a line-end hyphenation continuing on the next page. Signature "A 5" is printed at foot; the "5" is a page-number-style numeral, treated as signature. Some words in italic throughout; italics not marked due to running text transcription. Possible illegible letters in faded areas near "contemplans" and "ineuitabilem".
